integrity: Proof and standalone exact-rational checker included; mathematical assertions are same-author checked, with no independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Independent fixed occupancy per site, independent visits conditional on occupancy, externally known 0<f<p<1, unit visit costs.
All asymptotics are one-sided in occupancy psi tending to one with p and f fixed; finite survey budgets need separate analysis.
The OR estimator is untruncated; unknown or heterogeneous detection mechanisms can change design conclusions.
An especially relevant 1985 repeated-testing prevalence study was accessible only as a bibliographic abstract; historical priority is provisional.
title: Coarsened occupancy surveys have a sharp near-ubiquity replication phase
